assessment: Genetic forms of deafness are a major health challenge. This study deciphers the cochlear roles of repressor element 1–silencing transcription factor (REST), a gene involved in the DFNA27 dominant form of deafness, using the mouse as a model system. This study provides evidence for a pathophysiological mechanism of deafness and shows how genes involved in different forms of deafness may interact together. The article will be interesting to readers who work in the field of hearing research, REST regulation, or Kv7.4 regulation.
